verdict: Waters more than doubled revenue to $1.77B by adding Becton Dickinson's biosciences and diagnostics businesses, but acquisition accounting charges cut GAAP profit to $81M.

segments.name: Analytical Sciences Division
segments.note: Waters' core instruments, chemistry consumables and services — up 8% YoY, with double-digit instrument and chemistry growth.

segments.name: Advanced Diagnostics Division
segments.note: Clinical diagnostics, mostly from the acquired Becton Dickinson diagnostics business — prior-year Waters revenue here was only $64M.

segments.name: Biosciences Division
segments.note: Reagents and bioscience tools from the acquired Becton Dickinson biosciences business — a new division for Waters.

opex.name: Selling & administrative
opex.note: Selling and running the company, including acquisition-related costs.

opex.name: Purchased intangibles amortization
opex.note: Non-cash amortization of acquired intangible assets — $232M of it related to the BDS acquisition.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Developing new instruments, reagents and tests.

opex.name: Restructuring charges
opex.note: Charges to consolidate operations after the acquisition.

otherDetail: Interest expense, net $53M, plus about $1M of other expense implied by the reported pre-tax profit of $74M; other income was nil.
footerNote: Waters' fiscal third quarter ended October 3, 2026 — the Saturday closest to September 30.
oneTimers: BDS acquisition accounting dominates the GAAP figures: cost of revenue includes an $80M non-cash inventory and fixed-asset fair-value step-up, purchased intangibles amortization was $244M ($232M BDS-related), and Waters also recorded $54M of acquisition-related costs, $20M of restructuring and other items and $7M of ERP transformation costs. Excluding these, adjusted net income was $404M ($4.10 per share) versus GAAP net income of $81M ($0.82 per share), and adjusted operating income was $532M versus GAAP $128M.

takeaways.title: A much bigger company
takeaways.text: Reported revenue jumped 121% to $1,767M — $896M from the acquired BDS businesses and $871M organic. Organic growth alone was 9% (10% in constant currency), ahead of guidance.

takeaways.title: Adjusted earnings grew 21%
takeaways.text: Adjusted EPS rose 21% to $4.10 and Waters raised every part of its full-year 2026 guidance, saying integration and synergies are ahead of schedule.

takeaways.title: GAAP profit is the deal's shadow
takeaways.text: GAAP net income fell to $81M from $149M a year ago despite revenue doubling, because of roughly $400M of pre-tax acquisition accounting and deal charges running through the GAAP lines.

follow100Note: The tax line is a small benefit ($7M), not a bill, so it adds $0.40 per $100 of revenue.
